evidence.title: Can you detect AI? - by Ruben Hassid - How to AI

name: Can you detect AI?
summary: Paid newsletter post on how Substack's AI detector works and how to write so your text does not read as AI.
description: A post in Ruben Hassid's How to AI newsletter about Substack's AI detector and AI slop: how the detector works, how to stop sounding like an AI, and the author's own live AI writing workflow. Sections after the introduction are for paid subscribers.
